raw:
The user wants Taiwan Traditional Chinese UI strings for a computer peripherals settings page: pointer device speed and display brightness.

s1: pointer device speed label - "滑鼠速度" (mouse speed). The note says 鼠標 → 滑鼠. "指標裝置" is the pointer device, but the common Taiwan term is "滑鼠速度" or "游標速度". Actually in Windows Taiwan settings, it's "滑鼠速度" or "游標速度" (cursor speed / pointer speed). Windows 10 Taiwan: "滑鼠" settings, pointer speed is "選擇指標速度" hmm. The description says "調整指標裝置的移動速度" - pointer device could be mouse or touchpad. Common label: "滑鼠速度" but if it's a pointer device generally, "游標速度" or "指標速度" might be used. Windows Taiwan uses "滑鼠指標速度" hmm. Actually Windows 10 Taiwan: Settings > Devices > Mouse: "滑鼠指標速度" (Mouse pointer speed). Let me think: In Windows 10 Taiwanese, under Mouse settings, there's "滑鼠指標速度" slider. Also macOS Taiwan: "追蹤速度" for tracking speed.

Given the page description "指標裝置的移動速度", a good label: "滑鼠速度" or "指標速度". Since the mapping table only mentions 滑鼠, likely expected "滑鼠速度". But "指標裝置" could include touchpad (觸控板). Hmm. The safest Taiwan UI term: "滑鼠速度". Alternatively "游標速度" (cursor speed). Taiwan Windows uses "滑鼠". I'll go with "滑鼠速度".

s2: display brightness label - "螢幕亮度" (screen brightness). Taiwan: 螢幕亮度. Yes.

s3: settings page title - "滑鼠與螢幕" or "周邊設定"? The page adjusts pointer device speed and display brightness. Title could be "電腦周邊" or "周邊裝置". Hmm. Something like "滑鼠與螢幕設定" — like macOS "顯示器與滑鼠"? Windows has "滑鼠" and "顯示器". A combined page title: "滑鼠與顯示器"? Taiwan uses 顯示器 for monitor/display. But brightness for "顯示裝置" — could be screen. Title: "滑鼠與螢幕" perhaps. Or "周邊裝置". The page is "電腦周邊設定頁" - peripherals settings. Title: "滑鼠與螢幕" is descriptive. Given s1 and s2 are "滑鼠速度" and "螢幕亮度", title "滑鼠與螢幕" makes sense. Or "週邊設定" — note 周邊 vs 週邊: Taiwan often writes "週邊" or "周邊" both acceptable;教育部 prefers "周邊"? Actually Taiwan commonly uses "週邊" for peripheral devices (電腦週邊), though 周邊 is also used. The user wrote 周邊. I could use "滑鼠與螢幕" to avoid ambiguity.

I'll output: {"s1":"滑鼠速度","s2":"螢幕亮度","s3":"滑鼠與螢幕"}</think>{"s1":"滑鼠速度","s2":"螢幕亮度","s3":"滑鼠與螢幕"}
